reviews.title: Mathematically improbable
reviews.text:
Participated 5 times over how many years. Got my dad two times in a row until he died. Then a random one time participant. Now it’s the second year in a row I’ve gotten the same person.

Bells and whistles aside, all I’m here for is a random secret Santa drawing. And this? That’s not it smh.

reviews.title: Great. But a waste of storage
reviews.text:
Abhorrent waste of time. 

I used this app for 4 years for secret Santa at work, school, with friends and family. But this year I’m so let down. 

None of us use it anymore. Because whenever we use it, it kicks us off the app. Also, it says it doesn’t recognise our celebration!!! 

There are over two dozen of us and we all got kicked off!?!!?

Looking for a better app this year that doesn’t require every single person to download and login to the app.

reviews.title: App has changed 2025
reviews.text: You can no longer just type to add things to your “wish list”, you can only add specific items from the search engine within the app. Before you could just list  “knitted blanket” and leave it up the imagination of whoever drew your name. It’s annoying because it’s forcing you to only add links to your wish list so that whoever is buying the gift is paying a cut for the app by purchasing through the app… give us the option back!

reviews.title: Not Working
reviews.text: Got sign up. Signed up, created a list. Closed the web page and could not get back in. Had to get a code, apparently my email was invalid. Finally they blocked me and I had to reimbursed to my family group under a different email address. Got that done. Got into the group again. Created my list again. Lo and behold my email is invalid again and I am on a 24hour block. Again. This is beta testing at best. Would be zero stars if I could. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: Too Much *Required
reviews.text: I just want an app to draw names for secret Santa. That's it! I shouldn't have to jump through a million loopholes to get there. I put in all the names and even put in the names that certain people could not draw and I get to the end and it will not draw names unless you send out invitations and then even when you send out invitations it will not let you draw the names until people respond. Deleting app.

reviews.title: Website it okay but app is not usable
reviews.text: I’d been added to one secret Santa for work. I was using it to make the list on Safari. Then I thought I might want to use it with more people and got the app. The app doesn’t let me sign in. All the details were correct. I was signed out of safari. Just says there is an error. I’ll be using safari for work then and once we finish I won’t use it again cos even safari is janky but it’s better than not working at all
